positions.title: Principal Consultant - Data Scientist
positions.description:
Principal Data Scientist, Artificial Intelligence & Automation Group
Excels at coming up with solutions to hard business problems. Takes on all aspects of moving from proof of value into production, including Data Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning Ops, and Data Analytics. 

Built end-to-end retrieval augmented generation solution using GPT and deployed to Azure cloud over private document vector store in private virtual network.

Created and deployed SWIN-UNETR transformer model in PyTorch on Azure Machine Learning platform for computer vision which learned instance segmentation and classification of potentially cancerous segments in patient CT scans. Model cut radiology waiting time from days to minutes for clearly identifiable malignant and negative cases.

Created and deployed fully distributed data science solution on Ray, Spark, and Azure Databricks for Bayesian customer lifetime value model. Model analyzed the purchasing patterns of tens of millions of customers separately across multiple brand clusters to predict which customers are ready to buy specific brands in next thirty-day period.

Created and deployed a custom identity resolution system to aggregate customer information for tens of millions of customers spread through multiple, loosely-connected data sources across the company. The fully operational customer information platform provides value to all future marketing campaigns and an integrated view of client’s customer transactions hitherto unknow to client.

Llama-index (GPT-Index), Natural Language Processing, PyTorch, PySpark, Ray, Docker, Terraform, Bash, Git
